sections.heading: Many ways to say "become"
sections.body: English uses "become / get / turn"; Spanish chooses the verb by the **kind of change**:

head: Verb
Kind of change
Example
rows: *Se puso rojo.* — He went red. *Me pongo nerviosa.*
*Se volvió muy egoísta.* — He became very selfish.
through effort or gradually (job, status, beliefs)
*La ciudad se convirtió en un centro turístico.*
*Se quedó ciego / sordo / sin trabajo.* — He went blind / deaf / lost his job.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.body:
- *Ponerse* is also "to get" with emotions: *ponerse triste, contento, furioso, celoso* (jealous).
- *Hacerse* works with professions and religion: *se hizo abogado, se hizo vegetariano*. Also *hacerse viejo* (to get old) and *hacerse tarde* (to get late): *Se está haciendo tarde.*
- *Quedarse* also means "to stay": *Me quedé en casa.* With adjectives it's a result: *Me quedé sorprendido* (I was left surprised). *Quedarse embarazada* (to get pregnant).

examples: Se puso rojo cuando la vio.
He went red when he saw her.
Me pongo nerviosa antes de los exámenes.
I get nervous before exams.
Se puso furioso.
He got furious.
Se volvió muy egoísta con los años.
He became very selfish over the years.
Mi hermana se hizo médica.
My sister became a doctor.
Se hizo rico con su empresa.
He got rich with his company.
Me hice vegetariano el año pasado.
I became vegetarian last year.
Llegó a ser presidente del país.
He eventually became president of the country.
La ciudad se convirtió en un centro turístico.
The city turned into a tourist center.
El agua se convirtió en hielo.
The water turned into ice.
Se quedó sin trabajo.
He lost his job.
Mi abuelo se quedó ciego.
My grandfather went blind.
Me quedé sorprendida.
I was left surprised.
Se está haciendo tarde.
It's getting late.
Se pone celoso cuando hablo con otros.
He gets jealous when I talk to others.
Mi prima se quedó embarazada.
My cousin got pregnant.
Nos pusimos muy contentos con la noticia.
We got very happy about the news.

options: El agua se convirtió en hielo.
El agua se hizo en hielo.
